This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their splotchy [[Color|tan]] skin, with enlarged [[Bone|craniums]], prominent [[Nose|nasal bridges]], and and thin pointed [[ear]]s that stuck outward.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Thin-Pointy-Ears-Species.png|thumb|right|150px|A member of the species on Ghorman]]
In [[3 BBY]], one member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]],<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" /> while another could be found on the planet [[Ghorman]].<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref> A year later, at least two members of this species were present at the [[Imperial Senate Building]], panicking during [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Escape from the Senate|escape from the Senate]].<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref> Yet another year later, a member of this species could be found within the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] while [[Kleya Marki]] infiltrated the building in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop">{{Andor|Make It Stop}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Ever Been to Ghorman?|fourth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> [[Michael Wilkinson]], [[Mohen Leo]], and [[Neal Scanlan]] all had at least some hand in bringing this design to life.<ref name="Wilkinson">{{Instagram|username=michaelwilkinson|url=p/DMqEpKRxK0V/?img_index=5|name=[[Michael Wilkinson]]|date=2025-07-29|quote=Two of my favorite things about designing #Andor was working with the industry leader in visual effects, Industrial Light & Magic, overseen by Mohen Leo, as well as the legendary Neal Scanlan, head of creature and droid effects for the series. Both of them are geniuses and all around nice guys. They helped us achieve a beautiful fusion of costume, visual effects, and creatures.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/P0ogq}}</ref>
